protocol.task: RiNALMo official ArchiveII leave-one-family-out secondary structure

batch.epoch_batch_order: SeedSequence([seed, epoch]); identical for both heads

convergence.criterion: held-out validation upper-triangle BCE best checkpoint

protocol.single_variable: head architecture and native decoder on identical frozen RiNALMo embeddings; all-upper-triangle BCE fixed
protocol.training_truth: all upper-triangle pairs, including pseudoknots and noncanonical pairs; no legality mask or -inf in BCE
protocol.official_decoder: prob_mat_to_sec_struct; threshold selected once on best-checkpoint validation macro F1
protocol.jev_decoder: pair_mask_from_ids + nussinov_map_single noncrossing MAP; no threshold
protocol.metrics: per-structure tolerant ss_precision/ss_recall/ss_f1, then macro average; no strict micro metric

comparison.inference_scope: paired training-seed effects; no test-set population inference
